policy.rule: Life Plan / CCRC is a campus modality, not a replacement for Nevada licensing truth. Apply only to exact canonical entities on the verified campus; preserve each entity's licensed canonical_type.
policy.unknown_rule: No primary operator evidence or no exact canonical campus identity means UNKNOWN.

records.evidence_summary: HumanGood identifies Las Ventanas at Summerlin at 10401 W Charleston Blvd as Nevada's only Life Plan Community. The same campus offers independent living, assisted living, memory support, skilled nursing and short-stay rehabilitation.
